tests.title: Every write of a package through the library leaves a spec.md beside its artifacts
given: a package directory on disk holding a complete package and no spec.md
tests.when: the package is written through the library's three writers, in five cases: Save on a draft, Save on an active package, Transition from draft to active, Transition from active to sealed, and Supersede on a sealed package
then: after each write the directory holds spec.md
its bytes equal the bytes the library composes for the package that was written
the directory holds no file whose name matches *.tmp.*
tests.pseudocode: table in afspec/afspec_test.go, beside the other Save tests: for each writer case — dir = fixture package copied into t.TempDir(); spec = LoadSpec(dir); spec.Status = case.status; call case.write(spec, dir); assert readFile(dir+"/spec.md") == expectedRenderedBytes(resultingSpec); assert no glob match dir+"/*.tmp.*"

tests.title: The rendered bytes are the header line, a blank line and the package's whole render, and the library exposes the name and the bytes
given: a package held in memory, once with an architecture and once without
tests.when: the exported file name and the exported rendered bytes are asked of the library
then: the exported file name is spec.md
the first line is exactly the header comment of 15-REQ-1.2, naming the five artifacts and the speca --render call
the second line is empty
everything from the third line on is byte-identical to the package's unscoped, unbudgeted combined render
a file written from those bytes is byte-identical to the spec.md a save of the same package writes
tests.pseudocode: in afspec/render_test.go: b = spec.RenderedBytes(); lines = split(b, "\n"); assert lines[0] == header; assert lines[1] == ""; assert join(lines[2:], "\n") == spec.RenderCombined(); assert RenderedFileName == "spec.md"; then Save into a temp dir and assert the file on disk equals b

tests.title: The same package renders to the same bytes every time
given: three packages: an empty scaffold, a full package, and a package with an architecture
tests.when: each package's rendered bytes are composed twice in the same process, and a package reloaded from disk is composed again
then: the two compositions of each package are equal byte for byte
the composition of the reloaded package equals the composition of the one in memory
the bytes carry no timestamp other than the created_at and updated_at the PRD frontmatter already holds
tests.pseudocode: in afspec/render_test.go, beside TestRender_IsDeterministic: for each fixture — a = spec.RenderedBytes(); b = spec.RenderedBytes(); assert a == b; reloaded = LoadSpec(dir); assert reloaded.RenderedBytes() == a; assert the only RFC 3339 instants in a are spec.CreatedAt and spec.UpdatedAt

tests.title: A save that cannot write its temporary files leaves every file of the package as it was, spec.md included
given: a package directory holding a complete package, run once with no spec.md in it and once with a spec.md whose bytes are known
the directory made unwritable, so that creating a temporary file in it fails
tests.when: the package is saved through the library
then: the call returns a *SaveError
prd.md, requirements.json, test_spec.json, tasks.json and architecture.md are byte-identical to before the call
spec.md is still absent in the first case and byte-identical to before in the second
the directory holds no file whose name matches *.tmp.*
tests.pseudocode: in afspec/afspec_test.go, beside TestSave_LeavesNoTempFiles: before = hashEveryFile(dir); chmod(dir, 0o500) and skip when the test runs as root; err = spec.Save(dir); assert errors.As(err, &*afspec.SaveError); chmod back; assert hashEveryFile(dir) == before; assert no glob match dir+"/*.tmp.*"

tests.title: Loading a package reads none of a spec.md in its directory
given: one package directory copied twice: in one copy a spec.md holding the package's render, and in the other a spec.md holding unrelated text; a third copy with no spec.md at all
tests.when: each copy is loaded
then: the three loaded packages are equal field for field, apart from the directory each was loaded from
no field of any of them carries the bytes of the spec.md that was in its directory
tests.pseudocode: in afspec/afspec_test.go, beside TestLoadSpec_ReadsArchitectureOnlyWhenPresent: for each case — write the case's spec.md, s = LoadSpec(dir), s.Dir = ""; assert reflect.DeepEqual against the copy with no spec.md; assert the rendered-file text does not appear in s.PRDBody or s.Architecture

tests.title: The verdict warns about a missing render and says nothing about one that matches
given: a valid package on disk, loaded by the library, run once with no spec.md and once with a spec.md equal to its render, in each of the five lifecycle statuses
tests.when: the package is validated
then: with no spec.md there is exactly one warning whose check is rendered and whose artifact is spec.md, in every status
that warning's message says spec.md is missing and names the call speca <package> --render
the result stays valid
with a spec.md equal to the render there is no error and no warning whose check is rendered, in every status
tests.pseudocode: table in afspec/validate_test.go: for each (status, spec.md state) — prepare dir, s = LoadSpec(dir), v = s.Validate(); assert the entries with Check == "rendered" are what the case expects; assert v.Valid stays true

tests.title: A render that differs is an error for a draft or active package and a warning for a sealed, superseded or archived one
given: a valid package on disk whose spec.md has had one line changed, at a known line number, in each of the five lifecycle statuses
tests.when: the package is validated
then: for draft and for active there is exactly one error whose check is rendered and whose artifact is spec.md, and the result is not valid
for sealed, superseded and archived that finding is a warning instead, and the result stays valid
the message names the number of the first line that differs and the call speca <package> --render
tests.pseudocode: table in afspec/validate_test.go: for each status — write spec.md with line N replaced; s = LoadSpec(dir); v = s.Validate(); assert the rendered entry is in v.Errors or v.Warnings as the case expects; assert its message contains fmt.Sprint(N) and "--render"; assert v.Valid == case.valid

tests.title: A package the library did not read from disk gets no rendered finding
given: a package built in memory, its directory field set in turn to a path that does not exist, to an empty directory, and to a directory holding another package's spec.md
tests.when: the package is validated
then: no error and no warning whose check is rendered is reported, in any of the three cases
every other finding the package would get is reported as before
tests.pseudocode: table in afspec/validate_test.go: s = fixtureSpecInMemory(); s.Dir = case.dir; v = s.Validate(); assert no entry with Check == "rendered"; this is the dry-run case of specgen/pipeline.go, which sets Dir on a package it never wrote

tests.title: A spec.md that is there and cannot be read counts as a difference, not as absent
given: a valid package on disk whose spec.md exists with its read permission removed, run once as a draft and once as sealed
tests.when: the package is validated
then: exactly one finding whose check is rendered is reported, and its message carries the reason the read failed
it is an error for the draft package and a warning for the sealed one
its message does not say the file is missing
tests.pseudocode: in afspec/validate_test.go: write spec.md, chmod(path, 0o000) and skip when the test runs as root; s = LoadSpec(dir); v = s.Validate(); assert the rendered entry is where the status puts it and its message carries the permission error

tests.title: Activating a draft package whose render is stale is refused, and the package is left in draft
given: a draft package that validates on every other rule, whose spec.md differs from its render
tests.when: speca <package> --status active is run on it, once without --force and once with it
then: without --force the exit code is 1, the stage is validate, the rules named include rendered, and the message names speca <package> --render
the status in the package's prd.md is still draft and intent_hash is still null
with --force the package is activated and a high spec_invalid warning names the rendered rule
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/status_test.go, beside the other activation refusals: code = Main(["--dir", root, "15", "--status", "active"], &out, &err); assert code == 1; env = decode(out); assert env.error.stage == "validate" and "rendered" in env.error.message; assert frontmatter(dir).status == "draft"

tests.title: Rendering one package writes its spec.md, reports it written, and changes no other file
given: one package on disk in each of the five lifecycle statuses, each with no spec.md and then with a spec.md that differs from its render
tests.when: speca <package> --render is run on it
then: the exit code is 0 and result.rendered holds one entry for the package with rendered written
spec.md is byte-identical to the package's render
prd.md, requirements.json, test_spec.json, tasks.json and architecture.md are byte-identical to before the call, so the updated_at in prd.md is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/render_test.go: for each status and each starting state — before = hashEveryFileExcept(dir, "spec.md"); code = Main(["--dir", root, ref, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == 0; assert decode(out).result.rendered == [{spec_dir: ..., rendered: "written"}]; assert readFile(dir+"/spec.md") == renderedBytes(dir); assert hashEveryFileExcept(dir, "spec.md") == before

tests.title: Rendering a package whose render is already current reports it unchanged and leaves the file alone
given: one package on disk whose spec.md is byte-identical to its render
tests.when: speca <package> --render is run on it twice in a row
then: both calls exit 0 and report the package with rendered unchanged
the bytes and the modification time of spec.md are the same before and after each call
no file matching *.tmp.* is left in the directory
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: run --render once to make the file; stat and hash it; run --render again twice; assert result.rendered[0].rendered == "unchanged" each time; assert the hash and the ModTime are unchanged; assert no glob match dir+"/*.tmp.*"

tests.title: A dry run of the render form reports what would change and writes nothing
given: a spec root holding three packages: one with no spec.md, one whose spec.md is current, and one whose spec.md differs
tests.when: speca --render --dry-run is run over the spec root, and then speca <package> --render --dry-run on each package in turn
then: result.dry_run is true and the exit code is 0
the package with no spec.md and the one that differs are reported written, and the current one unchanged
no file in any package directory is created, changed or removed, spec.md included, and no file matching *.tmp.* appears
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: before = hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir); code = Main(["--dir", root, "--render", "--dry-run"], &out, &err); assert code == 0; env = decode(out); assert env.result.dry_run == true; assert the three entries' rendered values; assert hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir) == before

tests.title: The one-package render form fails on a package it cannot load and on a spec.md it cannot write
given: a package whose requirements.json is not valid JSON, and a valid package whose directory is not writable
tests.when: speca <package> --render is run on each
then: the unloadable package gives exit code 1 at stage load, with the directory and the library's reason in the message, and no file is written
the unwritable package gives exit code 1 at stage write, with the path and the reason in the message
in both cases every file of the package is byte-identical to before the call
tests.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/render_test.go, beside the two failure cases of the other forms: for each case — before = hashEveryFileUnder(dir); code = Main(["--dir", root, ref, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == 1; assert decode(out).error.stage == case.stage; assert hashEveryFileUnder(dir) == before

tests.title: The sweep renders every package of the spec root, and with --all those under archive/ too
given: a spec root holding three packages in number order and an archive/ holding two more, none of them with a spec.md
tests.when: speca --render is run with no package reference, and then speca --render --all
then: without --all there are three entries, in number order, and each of the three packages holds a spec.md equal to its render
the two packages under archive/ are untouched and hold no spec.md
with --all there are five entries: the three of the spec root in number order, then the two archived ones in number order, each archived entry carrying archived true
both calls exit 0
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go, following the shape of the --list tests: code = Main(["--dir", root, "--render"], &out, &err); entries = decode(out).result.rendered; assert the spec_dir values are the three in number order; then run with --all and assert the five, with Archived set on the last two

tests.title: One package that fails in the sweep does not stop the others
given: a spec root holding four packages, of which one has a prd.md the library refuses and one has a directory that is not writable
tests.when: speca --render is run with no package reference
then: the two broken packages are reported with rendered failed, each with a reason naming why
the other two are reported written and each holds a spec.md equal to its render
the exit code is 0 and every package of the spec root has an entry
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: break one package's prd.md and chmod another's directory to 0o500, skipping when the test runs as root; code = Main(["--dir", root, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == 0; assert the four entries' rendered values and that the two failed ones carry a reason

tests.title: The sweep fails on a spec root it cannot read and reports an empty list for one with no package
given: a --specs-dir naming a path that does not exist, a --specs-dir naming a regular file, and an existing but empty spec root
tests.when: speca --render is run with no package reference against each
then: the two unreadable roots give exit code 1 at stage load, with the root named in the message and a fix hint naming --specs-dir and AF_SPEC_DIR, and nothing written
the empty root gives exit code 0 and result.rendered encoded as []
tests.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/render_test.go, beside the matching --list case: for each case — code = Main(["--dir", root, "--specs-dir", case.dir, "--render"], &out, &err); assert code == case.code; for the failures assert error.stage == "load" and the fix hint's flag and env; for the empty root assert the raw JSON holds "rendered":[]

tests.title: The render form's summary sentence counts what was written, what was unchanged and what failed
given: a spec root holding four packages: one with no spec.md, one current, one stale, and one the library refuses
tests.when: speca --render is run with no package reference
then: the envelope's summary sentence carries the count written, the count unchanged and the count failed
those three counts are 2, 1 and 1
they add up to the number of entries in result.rendered
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/render_test.go: env = decode(out); assert env.summary names the three counts; assert written + unchanged + failed == len(env.result.rendered)

tests.title: The render form takes --dry-run and --all and refuses every other combination before anything is read
given: a spec root that would answer every form, so that a refusal cannot be the spec root's fault
tests.when: speca is run with --render combined in turn with --validate, --list, --task 1 --state done, --status active, --by 2, --force, --all and a package reference, and then with --dry-run, with --all and no reference, and with both
then: each of the first group exits 2 at stage usage, the message naming --render and the other flag
the --force case says --force has no effect with --render
the --all-with-a-reference case says --all adds the archive to the sweep and means nothing for one package
none of the refused calls reads a package or the spec root, and none writes a file
each of the second group exits 0, raising neither the refusal of --all without --list nor the refusal of --dry-run without the task or status form
tests.pseudocode: table in cmd/speca/main_test.go, extending TestUsageErrors and TestUsageErrors_AcceptEveryWellFormedTaskCall: for each argv — before = hashEveryFileUnder(root); code = Main(argv, &out, &err); assert code == case.code; assert decode(out).error.message contains case.says; assert hashEveryFileUnder(root) == before

tests.title: The self-description names the render flag and the list the form fills
given: nothing read from disk: --schema describes the command from its flag set and its Go types
tests.when: speca --schema is run
then: the flags object holds an entry named render, with the sentence that describes the form
the result schema holds rendered, and its entries carry spec_dir, rendered and reason
the golden file the schema test compares against holds the same document
tests.pseudocode: in cmd/speca/schema_test.go, extending TestSchema_DescribesTheFormsFlagsAndResult and regenerating the golden file of TestSchema_MatchesTheGoldenFile: doc = decode(stdout of Main(["--schema"])); assert doc.flags["render"] exists; assert doc.result properties hold "rendered" with those three fields

tests.title: An agent activates a draft package and the render is written with it
given: a real spec root holding a draft package that validates, with a spec.md equal to its render
tests.when: speca <package> --status active is run against the real directory and the real library
then: the call exits 0 and reports the status change from draft to active
the directory holds spec.md whose bytes equal the render of the activated package
spec.md carries the new status and the intent hash the activation computed
no file matching *.tmp.* is left in the directory
tests.pseudocode: end-to-end case in cmd/speca/e2e_test.go, beside TestAnAgentFollowsNextFromTheReportToTheFinishedTask: copy a fixture package into a real temp spec root, render it, activate it through Main, then read spec.md from disk and assert it holds "Status:** active" and the hash from the frontmatter
real_components: the afspec library's Transition and its atomic write
a real spec root on the file system

tests.title: An agent is told its render is stale and repairs it with one call
given: a real spec root holding a draft package whose spec.md is current
tests.when: a line of requirements.json is changed by hand, then speca <package> --validate, speca <package> --render and speca <package> --validate are run in turn
then: the first verdict is not valid and names the rendered rule, the first line that differs and the repairing call
the render call exits 0, reports the package written, and changes no other file of it
the second verdict holds no finding whose check is rendered and is valid
tests.pseudocode: end-to-end case in cmd/speca/e2e_test.go: edit a title in requirements.json; v1 = decode(Main([ref, "--validate"])); assert "rendered" in rules(v1); Main([ref, "--render"]); v2 = decode(Main([ref, "--validate"])); assert v2.result.valid and no rendered finding
real_components: the afspec library's validation and render
a real spec root on the file system

tests.title: A maintainer brings every committed render up to date after a renderer change
given: a real spec root holding three packages and an archive/ holding one, their spec.md files written by an earlier, different render
tests.when: speca --render --all --dry-run is run and then speca --render --all
then: the dry run reports every package that would change and writes no file
the real call exits 0, reports each package as written, unchanged or failed, and counts the three in the summary sentence
after it every package of the spec root and of archive/ holds a spec.md equal to its render
no file of any package other than spec.md changed between the two calls
tests.pseudocode: end-to-end case in cmd/speca/e2e_test.go: write a stale spec.md into each package; before = hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir); Main(["--render", "--all", "--dry-run"]); assert hashEveryFileUnder(specsDir) == before; Main(["--render", "--all"]); for each package assert readFile(spec.md) == renderedBytes(package); assert the only paths whose hash changed are the spec.md files
real_components: a real spec root with an archive/ on the file system
